# Fenwick Retainer Renewal

A retainer renewal for the client Fenwick was discussed in a call that covered fee structure.[^1] The standard two-week onboarding cadence was confirmed to carry over unchanged under the renewed terms.[^1] Whether to add an expanded compliance-audit scope to the renewed contract was left open, pending the client's board sign-off.[^1] No date was given for when that decision will land.[^1]

## Open Questions
- [ ] Will the expanded compliance-audit scope be added to the contract, pending board sign-off?[^1]
- [ ] When will the client's board decision be made, since no date was given?[^1]

[^1]: sessions/2026-05-01.md
